text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) demands questioning of civil servant who revealed secret information about the agency's secret plots against Iraq.
- Iraqi and Jordanian universities discuss cooperation.
- Cuba stresses its support to Iraq against the embargo.
- Iraq protests to the United Nations against U.S. planes' violation of Iraqi space.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Governor of the Iraqi Central Bank leaves to Amman to hold talks with governor of the Jordaninan Central Bank on means of enhancing cooperation.
